_comment: Named parts, each from its manufacturer's own data. This is the list that grows: an entry here is chosen when a board names the part (MPN or LCSC number), and never by value and package alone, because a 100 nF 0402 on a board is not evidence that it is this 100 nF 0402. Every entry MUST cite where its numbers came from - parse() refuses a vendor entry with no source - and the citation is what lets a number be checked or corrected later. Do not copy figures from the generic family and relabel them. The first parts are the MLCCs on JLCPCB's Basic Parts list (jlcpcb.com parts API, basic library, 2026-09-27) that have manufacturer models; docs/component-library.md lists the ones left out and why, and how to add a part.

sources.doc: Murata SPICE netlist GRM21BR61H106KE43.mod (static model, grm-n-v78 library)
sources.what: C, ESL and ESR extracted from the netlist, 0 V, 25 degC: ESR is Re Z at the 2.23 MHz notch, C is the capacitance a decade below it, ESL is Im Z / w a decade above it
